methodology: Counts src/main.ts only — the file each app's own index.html actually loads (<script type="module" src="/src/main.ts">). Neither app's main.ts imports ./p2p, so src/p2p.ts is dead code on both sides and is excluded from the headline number (reported separately below for transparency). Blank lines and comment-only lines are excluded from the "code" count; a trailing inline comment on a code line does not get stripped. HTML/CSS/tsconfig/package.json are configuration, not application logic, and are excluded from both sides equally.

excludedDeadCode.note: src/p2p.ts in each review-2-source copy — present in both source trees but never imported by main.ts or referenced by index.html. Not counted above; shown here so the exclusion is auditable, not hidden.
